summary: Drawer.Header ships, and two stale gaps close. The 48px chrome band is the row this component's own sheet draws on "Drawer Desktop" — back and forward chrome controls at the leading edge, a close at the trailing one — and it had never been built; Drawer had Title, Body and Footer and no Header, so a caller composing that panel built the row by hand. p-sm uniform, so 8 + 32 + 8 = 48 makes the padding and the pinned height agree rather than one of them being a second author of the inset. Sheet.Header's values exactly, both having been drawn on this artboard. It carries no scrolled hairline, unlike Sheet.Header: this sheet draws no scrolled state and inventing one is how a drawing stops being a contract. It is an ADDITION to the drag handle rather than a replacement — the handle is the drag affordance and the single-pointer alternative SC 2.5.7 requires, so whether the desktop form drops it is a question for design and is now in needsDesign rather than answered here. Separately: the story's two SELECT fields are real Selects now. They stood in as Inputs while Select did not exist, and the stand-in outlived its reason — the knownGap and a duplicate needsDesign row both said "there is no Select component in this system yet" while Select shipped.
